author: Cool Worlds
description:
Use code coolworlds at https://incogni.com/coolworlds to get an exclusive 60% off an annual Incogni plan.

Head to an exoplanet seminar or conference and you'll constantly hear astronomers talking about "the Cosmic Shoreline". But - what the heck is that? Why is it so important? And why is JWST dedicating a huge amount of telescope time to studying it?

Written & presented by David Kipping, edited by Jorge Casas
